properties.displayName: SCF - Manual attestation for Encryption Key Lifecycle Management and Rotation Control
properties.description: This policy requires manual attestation to confirm that encryption keys are rotated regularly in accordance with SCB policies and guidelines. The key rotation interval is based on the application’s risk profile, and a Security Officer will provide advice and guidance on determining the appropriate interval.
